description:
Three independent decoders of :specled_ex, :spec_cover_run across Boundary + Formatter already disagree on table validity (is_reference or is_atom vs any non-nil), plus duplicated default_snapshot_fn/1 and the leaked modules_cache_key/0. Extract one arming resolver returning {:armed, config} | :disarmed. Report F5.

---

## Orchestrator scoping (synthesized 2026-07-25 by /orchestrate-epic from verified code analysis)

## specled_-dn4.4 — Unify the arming-seam decoders behind one resolver (F5)

**Advances:** `specled.coverage_capture`

Matched obligations: `specled.coverage_capture.formatter_arming_seam` (:211-226) and `specled.coverage_capture.boundary_noop_unarmed` (:460-468) — the two requirements that *separately* describe the same seam, which is the root of the divergence. Also `specled.coverage_capture.formatter_snapshot_fn_di` (:199-210), which pins the production default.

**Primary files — the three decoders, verified to disagree:**

1. `lib/specled_ex/coverage/boundary.ex:90-108` `defp resolve_config/0` — matches `opts when is_list(opts)` only (so seam value `true` is `:unarmed`), then accepts **any non-nil** `Keyword.get(opts, :boundary_table)` as a valid tid (:93-103).
2. `lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex:133-139` `defp armed/0` — matches `is_list(opts)` **and** `true -> []`, and never looks at `:boundary_table`.
3. `lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex:413-441` `defp load_boundary_index/0` — matches `is_list(opts)` then requires `tid when is_reference(tid) or is_atom(tid)` (:417). **This is the concrete disagreement with (1):** an armed seam carrying a non-ref/non-atom `:boundary_table` makes `Boundary` write rows that the formatter then silently ignores.

Also in scope, as named by the ticket:

- Duplicated `defp default_snapshot_fn(modules), do: Snapshot.take(Snapshot.runtime_mode(), modules)` — `boundary.ex:128` and `formatter.ex:145`, byte-identical.
- The leaked accessor `@doc false def modules_cache_key, do: @modules_key` — `boundary.ex:86-88`, whose sole consumer is `formatter.ex:423` (`SpecLedEx.Coverage.Boundary.modules_cache_key()`), plus the test assertion at `test/specled_ex/coverage/boundary_test.exs:97`.
- Target shape per the ticket: one resolver returning `{:armed, config} | :disarmed`.
- Third arming writer to keep consistent: `lib/mix/tasks/spec.cover.test.ex:197-198` (`:ets.new(:anon, [:public, :set])` then `Application.put_env(:specled_ex, :spec_cover_run, boundary_table: boundary_table)`).
- `@arming_app :specled_ex` / `@arming_key :spec_cover_run` are duplicated at `boundary.ex:18-19` and `formatter.ex:113-114`.

If the resolver lands as a new module (e.g. `lib/specled_ex/coverage/arming.ex`), it must be added to `coverage_capture.spec.md`'s `surface:` list (:81-102) or the file will be unmapped.

**Allowed touches (globs):**

- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/boundary.ex`
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex`
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/arming.ex` (new, if extracted as its own module)
- `lib/mix/tasks/spec.cover.test.ex` (only if the arming write shape changes)
- `test/specled_ex/coverage/boundary_test.exs`
- `test/specled_ex/coverage/formatter_test.exs`
- `test/specled_ex/coverage/arming_test.exs` (new)
- `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md`
- `.spec/realization_hashes.json`
- `CHANGELOG.md`

**Out of Scope (files):** `lib/specled_ex/coverage.ex`, `lib/specled_ex/coverage/snapshot.ex`, `lib/specled_ex/coverage/store.ex`, `lib/specled_ex/review/**`, `lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex`, `docs/**`, `.spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md`, `.spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md`, `.spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md`.

**Out of Scope (intent):**

- Pick **one** table-validity predicate and say so in the spec — do not leave both `is_reference or is_atom` and "any non-nil" alive behind a new façade.
- Do not change the observable arming contract: seam `true` must still activate the formatter with production defaults and must still leave `Boundary` unarmed (that asymmetry is deliberate and is asserted at `test/specled_ex/coverage/boundary_test.exs:32-35`).
- No new deps; no `Application.put_env` from library code.

**Verification:**

- `mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/boundary_test.exs test/specled_ex/coverage/formatter_test.exs test/specled_ex/case_test.exs test/mix/tasks/spec_cover_test_test.exs`
- `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` (surface-list completeness for a new module, plus realization drift on `Boundary.head/1`, `Boundary.tail`, `Formatter`, `Formatter.init/1`)
- Stubs, both **`execute: true`**: `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md:898-902` (`formatter_arming_seam`, `formatter_no_fabrication`), :943-947 (`boundary_noop_unarmed`, `envelope_meta`), and :891-897 (`formatter_snapshot_fn_di`).

**Overlap risk:**

- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/boundary.ex` — **dn4.1** (`tail/3`→`tail/2` changes the very clause `resolve_config/0` feeds), **dn4.6** (chained windows), **dn4.9** (`table_alive?/1` at :122-126 becomes `:ets.info(tid, :size)`; `modules_for/1` at :110-120 becomes a `persistent_term` cache; rescue-based insert replaces the `table_alive?` pre-check at :68).
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex` — **dn4.2** (`flush/1`, which calls `load_boundary_index/0`), **dn4.5**, **dn4.9** (`disarmed_notice/0` inlining).
- `test/specled_ex/coverage/boundary_test.exs` — **dn4.1**, **dn4.6**, **dn4.9**.
- dn4.9's "`persistent_term` modules cache" would **delete** `modules_cache_key/0` outright, which is exactly the leak dn4.4 is asked to close. Decide ownership once: recommend dn4.4 closes the leak by keeping ETS and making the key private to the resolver, and dn4.9 drops its `persistent_term` item or rebases onto it.

---


**Orchestrator ruling (ownership of the modules cache):** dn4.4 owns closing the `modules_cache_key/0` leak. Keep the ETS-based modules lookup and make the key private to the new resolver. Do NOT convert to `persistent_term` here — that evaluation belongs to dn4.9, which runs after you and will build on your landed design.
